prompt:
Our creative team has been stuck in a visual rut — every AI-generated image we produce looks the same. We've manually curated a set of brutalist UI design references saved at `campaigns/q3_brutalist/manual_shots.json` that we want to feed into our visual reference pipeline.

Please run the full reference pipeline using those manually collected shots, then generate a fresh, high-quality image prompt for our Q3 Urban Edge campaign. The prompt should draw from the design references and feel distinctly different from anything we've generated recently.

Save the final deliverable as `final_prompt.json`.
